events.descriptionEn: After the failure of the fifth counter-encirclement campaign, Nationalist forces kept pressing and blockading the Central Soviet Area, forcing strategic transfer.

events.title: 中央红军主力开始战略转移
events.description: 中共中央、中革军委率中央红军主力从中央苏区出发，开始战略转移。数据以瑞金、于都一带作为可视化起点，实际出发涉及多地集结与渡河。
events.titleEn: Central Red Army begins a strategic march at Ruijin and Yudu area, Jiangxi
events.descriptionEn: On Oct 10, 1934, the Central Red Army began a strategic transfer and opened this route segment around Ruijin and Yudu area, Jiangxi. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 中央红军在于都完成集结
events.description: 1934年10月16日，中央红军在江西于都一带在于都完成集结。

events.title: 中央红军渡过于都河
events.description: 中央红军从于都等地夜渡于都河，离开中央苏区腹地。此点用于把起点从政治中心推进到实际行军路线。
events.titleEn: Central Red Army crosses a major river at Yudu, Jiangxi
events.descriptionEn: On Oct 17, 1934, the Central Red Army crossed a major river and changed the operational situation around Yudu, Jiangxi. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 突破第一道封锁线
events.description: 中央红军离开中央苏区后，先后突破敌军数道封锁线，继续向湘粤桂边界推进。

location.name: 赣南安远/信丰一带
location.nameEn: Anyuan and Xinfeng area, southern Jiangxi

events.titleEn: Central Red Army breaks through blockade lines at Anyuan and Xinfeng area, southern Jiangxi
events.descriptionEn: On Oct 21, 1934, the Central Red Army broke through blockade pressure and kept moving around Anyuan and Xinfeng area, southern Jiangxi. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 洪超在百石战斗中牺牲
events.description: 红三军团红四师师长洪超在江西信丰百石村一带战斗中牺牲。该条目补入长征初期突围线上的高级指挥员牺牲。
events.notes: 长征初期高级指挥员牺牲
events.titleEn: Hong Chao dies at Baishi
events.descriptionEn: Hong Chao, commander of the Red Fourth Division of the Third Corps, was killed in the fighting around Baishi during the early breakout.
events.casualties: 洪超牺牲，时任红三军团红四师师长。

events.title: 中央红军集结待命
events.description: 1934年10月25日，中央红军在江西信丰百石村一带集结待命。

events.title: 红二、红六军团出发前往四川酉阳县南腰界地区的猫洞大田
events.description: 1934年10月26日，红二、红六军团在福建大田一带出发前往四川酉阳县南腰界地区的猫洞大田。

events.title: 中央红军在兴安/全州湘江一线集结
events.description: 1934年10月30日，中央红军在广西兴安/全州湘江一线一带在兴安/全州湘江一线集结。

location.name: 广西兴安/全州湘江一线

events.title: 红四方面军召开了政治工作会议
events.description: 1934年11月初，红四方面军在四川通江毛裕镇一带召开了政治工作会议。

events.title: 红四方面军召开军事会议
events.description: 1934年11月中旬，红四方面军在四川巴中清江一带召开军事会议。

events.title: 红二十五军突破了敌军四道封锁线
events.description: 1934年11月6日，红二十五军在河南罗山葛藤山一带突破了敌军四道封锁线。

events.title: 南梁革命根据地建设推进
events.description: 陕甘边革命根据地以南梁为中心逐步发展，为后续陕甘、陕北革命根据地联结奠定基础。此类条目用于说明长征最终落脚点并非凭空出现，而是由西北红军长期开拓形成。
events.titleEn: Shaan-Gan Red Army builds a base area at Nanliang, Huachi, Gansu
events.descriptionEn: On Nov 7, 1934, the Shaan-Gan Red Army built or consolidated a revolutionary base connected to the final landing point around Nanliang, Huachi, Gansu. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 红二十五军北上抗日的通知、7月29日中央书记处关于
events.description: 1934年11月8日，红二十五军在鄂豫皖根据地一带北上抗日的通知、7月29日中央书记处关于。

events.title: 红二十五军北上抗日第二先遣队
events.description: 1934年11月11日，红二十五军在鄂豫皖根据地一带北上抗日第二先遣队。

events.title: 连续突破第三道封锁线
events.description: 中央红军向湘江方向推进，连续突破敌军封锁，但部队在持续追击与堵截中消耗加重。

location.name: 湘南宜章/临武一带
location.nameEn: Yizhang and Linwu area, southern Hunan

events.titleEn: Central Red Army breaks through blockade lines at Yizhang and Linwu area, southern Hunan
events.descriptionEn: On Nov 15, 1934, the Central Red Army broke through blockade pressure and kept moving around Yizhang and Linwu area, southern Hunan. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 红二十五军从何家冲开始长征
events.description: 红二十五军高举北上抗日第二先遣队旗帜，从河南罗山何家冲出发，开始战略转移。
events.titleEn: Red Twenty-Fifth Army begins a strategic march at Hejiachong, Luoshan, Henan
events.descriptionEn: On Nov 16, 1934, the Red Twenty-Fifth Army began a strategic transfer and opened this route segment around Hejiachong, Luoshan, Henan. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 红二十五军发布了中国工农红军北上抗日第二先遣队出发宣言
events.description: 1934年11月16日，红二十五军在鄂豫皖根据地一带发布了中国工农红军北上抗日第二先遣队出发宣言。

events.title: 红二、红六军团占领桑植、大庸两县城
events.description: 1934年11月17日，红二、红六军团在湖南大庸/张家界一带占领桑植、大庸两县城。

events.title: 中央红军攻占道县城
events.description: 1934年11月22日，中央红军在广西兴安/全州湘江一线一带攻占道县城。

location.name: 广西兴安/全州湘江一线

events.title: 中央红军占领水口
events.description: 1934年11月24日，中央红军在福建闽侯水口一带占领水口。

events.title: 中央红军突破国民党军的第四道封锁线
events.description: 1934年11月25日，中央红军在福建闽侯水口一带突破国民党军的第四道封锁线。

events.title: 红二、红六军团成立
events.description: 1934年11月25日，红二、红六军团在湖南大庸/张家界一带成立。

events.title: 红二十五军独树镇战斗
events.description: 红二十五军在河南方城独树镇七里岗附近遭优势敌军包围，27日冲出包围，保存有生力量。
events.titleEn: Red Twenty-Fifth Army fights a battle at Dushuzhen, Fangcheng, Henan
events.descriptionEn: On Nov 26, 1934, the Red Twenty-Fifth Army fought a battle that affected the next stage of movement around Dushuzhen, Fangcheng, Henan. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 中央红军占领了道县
events.description: 1934年11月26日，中央红军在福建永安一带占领了道县。

events.title: 红二、红六军团成立
events.description: 1934年11月26日，红二、红六军团在湖南大庸/张家界一带成立。

events.title: 湘江一线形成多重封锁
events.description: 敌军在湘江沿线形成严密封锁，试图截断中央红军西进通道，湘江战役由此成为长征初期最惨烈的战役之一。

location.name: 广西全州湘江一线
location.nameEn: Xiang River line at Quanzhou, Guangxi

events.titleEn: Multiple blockade lines form along the Xiang River
events.descriptionEn: Enemy forces formed dense blockades along the Xiang River, attempting to cut off the westward movement of the Central Red Army.

events.title: 湘江战役开始
events.description: 中央红军突破第四道封锁线，在湘江两岸付出重大代价。渡过湘江后，中央红军由出发时8.6万余人锐减至3万余人。

location.name: 广西兴安/全州湘江一线

events.titleEn: Central Red Army conducts a campaign at Xing'an-Quanzhou Xiang River line, Guangxi
events.descriptionEn: On Nov 27, 1934, the Central Red Army conducted a campaign that shaped the movement of nearby columns around Xing'an-Quanzhou Xiang River line, Guangxi. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.
events.casualties: 湘江战役后中央红军由8万余人锐减至约3万余人，损失极为惨重。

events.title: 红二十五军占领五里坡、高老山一带高地
events.description: 1934年11月27日，红二十五军在河南伏牛山一带一带占领五里坡、高老山一带高地。

events.title: 红二十五军渡过澧河
events.description: 1934年11月28日，红二十五军在湖南通道一带渡过澧河。

events.title: 中央红军在兴安/全州湘江一线突破封锁
events.description: 1934年11月29日，中央红军在广西兴安/全州湘江一线一带在兴安/全州湘江一线突破封锁。

location.name: 广西兴安/全州湘江一线

events.title: 红三十四师等部血战湘江，掩护主力突围
events.description: 湘江战役中，红五军团第34师和红三军团第18团等部担负掩护任务，与数倍敌军苦战，大部壮烈牺牲。

location.name: 广西全州湘江一线
location.nameEn: Xiang River line at Quanzhou, Guangxi

events.titleEn: The 34th Division fights at the Xiang River to cover the main force
events.descriptionEn: During the Xiang River Campaign, the 34th Division and related covering units fought against overwhelming enemy forces, suffering devastating losses while protecting the main column.
events.casualties: 红三十四师等部大部牺牲

events.title: 越过五岭余脉，湘江突围后继续西进
events.description: 湘江战役后，中央红军在五岭山地间艰难西进。山川阻隔与敌军追堵交织，长征的艰难在此集中展开。
events.titleEn: Central Red Army faces severe terrain at Yuechengling area in northern Guangxi
events.descriptionEn: On Dec 1, 1934, the Central Red Army faced difficult terrain, supply pressure, and exhaustion around Yuechengling area in northern Guangxi. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

poem.title: 五岭并非细浪
poem.text: 五岭山地横亘南方，行军并不轻松。诗句把连绵山脉写成“细浪”，显出红军面对万水千山的气魄。

events.title: 红四方面军开始了创建新的根据地的斗争
events.description: 1934年12月，红四方面军在贵州遵义一带开始了创建新的根据地的斗争。

events.title: 中央红军开始翻越老山界
events.description: 1934年12月4日，中央红军在湖南通道一带开始翻越老山界。

events.title: 红二、红六军团出发
events.description: 1934年12月5日，红二、红六军团在湖南大庸/张家界一带出发。

events.title: 红二、红六军团抵达沅陵城外东北方鸳鸯山、丁公庙一带
events.description: 1934年12月7日，红二、红六军团在湖南沅陵鸳鸯山一带抵达沅陵城外东北方鸳鸯山、丁公庙一带。

events.title: 红二十五军到达雒南县的庾家河宿营
events.description: 1934年12月9日，红二十五军在陕西商洛庾家河一带到达雒南县的庾家河宿营。

events.title: 陈树湘壮烈牺牲，红三十四师成为“绝命后卫”
events.description: 红三十四师师长陈树湘在湘江突围后负伤被俘，最终壮烈牺牲。“为苏维埃流尽最后一滴血”的事迹成为长征壮烈精神的重要象征。
events.titleEn: Chen Shuxiang dies after the Xiang River breakout
events.descriptionEn: Chen Shuxiang, commander of the 34th Division, was wounded and captured after the Xiang River breakout and died heroically, becoming a symbol of sacrifice on the Long March.

events.title: 红二十五军越过伏牛山，转入豫陕边
events.description: 独树镇突围后，红二十五军向伏牛山、豫陕边转进，开始在鄂豫陕边创建新的活动空间。
events.titleEn: The 25th Red Army crosses the Funiu Mountains toward the Henan-Shaanxi border
events.descriptionEn: After breaking through at Dushuzhen, the 25th Red Army moved into the Funiu Mountains and the Henan-Shaanxi border region.

events.title: 红二十五军庾家河会议后转入鄂豫陕
events.description: 红二十五军在转战中调整战略方向，推动创建鄂豫陕根据地，并继续承担北上抗日先遣队角色。
events.titleEn: Red Twenty-Fifth Army holds a key meeting at Yu Jiahe, Shangluo, Shaanxi
events.descriptionEn: On Dec 10, 1934, the Red Twenty-Fifth Army held a political or military meeting that influenced later decisions around Yu Jiahe, Shangluo, Shaanxi. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 红二十五军召开了第十八次常委会议
events.description: 1934年12月10日，红二十五军在鄂豫皖根据地一带召开了第十八次常委会议。

events.title: 中央红军占领通道县城
events.description: 1934年12月11日，中央红军在湖南通道一带占领通道县城。

events.title: 通道会议调整进军方向
events.description: 中央红军在湘桂黔边境转向贵州方向，避免继续按原计划与敌重兵相撞。此条目作为遵义会议前军事路线调整的铺垫。
events.titleEn: Central Red Army holds a key meeting at Tongdao, Hunan
events.descriptionEn: On Dec 12, 1934, the Central Red Army held a political or military meeting that influenced later decisions around Tongdao, Hunan. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 中央红军占领黎平和老锦屏
events.description: 1934年12月15日，中央红军在贵州黎平一带占领黎平和老锦屏。

events.title: 红二、红六军团抵达浯溪河附近
events.description: 1934年12月15日，红二、红六军团在湖南桃源浯溪河一带抵达浯溪河附近。

events.title: 红二、红六军团开始后撤
events.description: 1934年12月16日，红二、红六军团在湖南桃源浯溪河一带开始后撤。

events.title: 红二、红六军团占领桃源县城
events.description: 1934年12月17日，红二、红六军团在湖南桃源一带占领桃源县城。

events.title: 黎平会议决定向黔北进军
events.description: 中央政治局在黎平召开会议，采纳向黔北进军的主张，为后续占领遵义和召开遵义会议创造条件。
events.titleEn: Central Red Army holds a key meeting at Liping, Guizhou
events.descriptionEn: On Dec 18, 1934, the Central Red Army held a political or military meeting that influenced later decisions around Liping, Guizhou. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 中央红军占领施秉、黄平
events.description: 1934年12月19日，中央红军在贵州遵义一带占领施秉、黄平。

events.title: 中央红军出发
events.description: 1934年12月20日，中央红军在贵州黎平一带出发。

events.title: 红二、红六军团占领慈利县城
events.description: 1934年12月26日，红二、红六军团在湖南慈利一带占领慈利县城。

events.title: 中央红军占领黄平
events.description: 1934年12月28日，中央红军在贵州瓮安猴场一带占领黄平。

events.title: 中央红军抢渡乌江、向黔北进发
events.description: 1934年12月31日，中央红军在贵州瓮安猴场一带抢渡乌江、向黔北进发。

events.title: 猴场会议限制军事指挥权集中于少数人
events.description: 猴场会议要求重大军事行动须经中央政治局讨论，为遵义会议前进一步纠正错误指挥创造条件。
events.titleEn: Central Red Army holds a key meeting at Houchang, Weng'an, Guizhou
events.descriptionEn: On Jan 1, 1935, the Central Red Army held a political or military meeting that influenced later decisions around Houchang, Weng'an, Guizhou. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 陕甘红军成立了革命委员会
events.description: 1935年1月，陕甘红军在陕西安定一带一带成立了革命委员会。

events.title: 中央红军召开会议
events.description: 1935年1月1日，中央红军在贵州黎平一带召开会议。

events.title: 红四方面军发起广昭战役
events.description: 1935年1月下旬，红四方面军在四川广元/剑阁一带一带发起广昭战役。

events.title: 中央红军召开了紧急会议
events.description: 1935年1月2日，中央红军在贵州乌江一线一带召开了紧急会议。

events.title: 中央红军开始
events.description: 1935年1月3日，中央红军在贵州乌江一线一带开始。

events.title: 中央红军攻占遵义的计划
events.description: 1935年1月5日，中央红军在贵州遵义一带攻占遵义的计划。

events.title: 中央红军出发
events.description: 1935年1月6日，中央红军在贵州乌江一线一带出发。

events.title: 中央红军占领遵义
events.description: 中央红军进入遵义，为召开具有转折意义的遵义会议创造条件。
events.titleEn: Central Red Army reaches a key point at Zunyi, Guizhou
events.descriptionEn: On Jan 7, 1935, the Central Red Army reached an important destination in the route sequence around Zunyi, Guizhou. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 中央红军占领桐梓
events.description: 1935年1月8日，中央红军在贵州娄山关一带占领桐梓。

events.title: 中央红军开始进攻
events.description: 1935年1月9日，中央红军在贵州娄山关一带开始进攻。

events.title: 敌军向黔北追堵，遵义周边压力上升
events.description: 中央红军进入黔北后，敌军继续向遵义周边压迫。军事危局与路线调整共同构成遵义会议的背景。
events.titleEn: Enemy pressure rises around Zunyi
events.descriptionEn: After the Central Red Army entered northern Guizhou, enemy pressure continued around Zunyi, forming the military context of the Zunyi Meeting.

events.title: 红二十五军开辟鄂豫陕根据地
events.description: 红二十五军进入鄂豫陕边后，依托山地与群众工作创建新的游击根据地，形成“星星之火”式的支线铺开。
events.titleEn: The 25th Red Army develops the Hubei-Henan-Shaanxi base area
events.descriptionEn: In the border region, the 25th Red Army developed a new guerrilla base through mountain warfare and mass work.

events.title: 中央红军成立大会
events.description: 1935年1月12日，中央红军在贵州遵义一带成立大会。

events.title: 遵义会议召开
events.description: 中共中央政治局在遵义召开扩大会议，集中解决军事和组织问题，结束王明“左”倾教条主义在中共中央的统治，确立毛泽东在党和红军中的领导地位。

events.description: 中央红军一渡赤水后，国民党军调集多路部队试图在川黔边界围堵红军。

events.title: 红四方面军占领宁羌、沔县（今勉县）、阳平关重镇

events.title: 贺子珍川南生女并含泪托孤

events.titleEn: The Zhaxi meetings continue organizational and military adjustments
events.descriptionEn: After the Zunyi Meeting, the Central Red Army moved through the Sichuan-Yunnan-Guizhou border area; meetings near Zhaxi continued the adjustment of leadership and military deployment.

events.title: 中央红军召开营、科长以上干部会议
events.description: 1935年2月10日，中央红军在贵州遵义一带召开营、科长以上干部会议。

events.title: 中央红军开始向东进军
events.description: 1935年2月11日，中央红军在云南威信扎西一带开始向东进军。

events.title: 红二、红六军团突破敌军的围攻线
events.description: 1935年2月11日，红二、红六军团在贵州乌江一线一带突破敌军的围攻线。

events.title: 陕甘边与陕北革命根据地统一为陕甘革命根据地
events.description: 陕甘边革命根据地与陕北革命根据地统一为陕甘革命根据地，又称西北革命根据地，成为土地革命战争后期保存较完整的重要根据地。

location.nameEn: Shaanxi-Gansu border and northern Shaanxi base areas

events.titleEn: Shaan-Gan Red Army builds a base area at Shaanxi-Gansu border and northern Shaanxi base areas

This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 二渡赤水，回师黔北
events.description: 中央红军由太平渡、二郎滩等地二渡赤水，回师黔北，寻机打击敌军。

events.title: 谢子长逝世，西北根据地继续坚持
events.description: 西北红军和陕北苏区创建人之一谢子长逝世。该条目用于说明长征落脚点背后已有长期牺牲和根据地建设。
events.titleEn: Xie Zichang dies in northern Shaanxi
events.descriptionEn: Xie Zichang, one of the founders of the northwestern Red Army and Shaanbei base, died before the main Red Army arrived. The node keeps the landing point's earlier sacrifices visible.
events.casualties: 谢子长逝世，陕北根据地继续坚持。

events.title: 陕甘红军反围剿
events.description: 1935年2月21日，陕甘红军在陕西子长瓦窑堡一带反围剿。

events.title: 中央红军发起突袭
events.description: 1935年2月24日，中央红军在贵州娄山关一带发起突袭。

events.title: 娄山关战斗与遵义大捷
events.description: 中央红军夺取娄山关并再克遵义，是长征以来一次重要胜利，提振士气。
events.titleEn: Central Red Army fights a battle at Loushan Pass, Guizhou
events.descriptionEn: On Feb 25, 1935, the Central Red Army fought a battle that affected the next stage of movement around Loushan Pass, Guizhou. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 邓萍在遵义城下侦察敌情时牺牲
events.description: 红三军团参谋长邓萍在遵义战役前线侦察敌情时中弹牺牲，是长征途中牺牲的红军高级指挥员之一。
events.titleEn: Central Red Army records a sacrifice at old city of Zunyi, Guizhou

events.descriptionEn: Near Gouba south of Zunyi, Red Army leaders debated operational choices under urgent military pressure, showing how decisions were repeatedly weighed amid crisis.

events.title: 中央红军占领遵义

events.title: 南渡乌江，佯逼贵阳
events.description: 中央红军南渡乌江并向贵阳方向运动，调动敌军，为西进云南、北渡金沙江创造条件。
events.titleEn: Central Red Army crosses a major river at Wu River line, Guizhou

events.description: 中央红军南渡乌江后佯逼贵阳，迫使敌军调动，为随后西进云南、巧渡金沙江创造条件。
events.titleEn: Central Red Army maneuvers along the route at Guiyang area, Guizhou

events.title: 中央红军到达息烽西北地区

events.title: 红二、红六军团转移

events.title: 红二、红六军团发起猛攻

events.titleEn: The Jialing River Campaign ends with the Fourth Front Army pushing west
events.descriptionEn: After crossing the Jialing River, the Fourth Front Army fought for more than twenty days and pushed toward the Sichuan-Gansu border.

events.title: 云南方向试图封锁金沙江渡口

events.titleEn: Enemy forces attempt to block Jinsha River crossings
events.descriptionEn: As the Red Army approached the Jinsha River, enemy forces tried to block the ferries, but rapid maneuver secured crossing points.

events.descriptionEn: On Aug 15, 1936, the Red Fourth Front Army faced difficult terrain, supply pressure, and exhaustion around northwestern Sichuan grasslands. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 红四方面军占领漳县
events.description: 1936年8月19日，红四方面军在四川若尔盖包座一带占领漳县。

events.title: 红二方面军通过草地抵近甘南
events.description: 红二方面军通过草地，进抵甘南地区，随后开展成徽两康等行动。
events.titleEn: Red Second Front Army faces severe terrain at grasslands along the Sichuan-Gansu border
events.descriptionEn: On Aug 20, 1936, the Red Second Front Army faced difficult terrain, supply pressure, and exhaustion around grasslands along the Sichuan-Gansu border. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 红四方面军向甘南推进，接近会宁方向
events.description: 红四方面军走出川西北后向甘南、陇东南推进，逐步靠近红一方面军接应区域，会师态势开始显现。
events.titleEn: The Fourth Front Army advances toward southern Gansu and Huining
events.descriptionEn: After leaving northwestern Sichuan, the Fourth Front Army advanced toward southern Gansu and the Huining area.

events.title: 红二、红六军团到达哈达铺
events.description: 1936年9月1日，红二、红六军团在甘肃宕昌哈达铺一带到达哈达铺。

events.title: 红四方面军占领通渭
events.description: 1936年9月7日，红四方面军在甘肃会宁一带占领通渭。

events.title: 红二、红六军团召开会议
events.description: 1936年9月7日，红二、红六军团在甘肃宕昌哈达铺一带召开会议。

events.title: 红四方面军进入甘南并控制漳县、渭源、通渭等地区
events.description: 红四方面军北上后进入甘肃南部，控制漳县、渭源、通渭等地区，为会宁会师铺开路线。

location.name: 甘肃通渭/渭源/漳县一带
location.nameEn: Tongwei, Weiyuan, and Zhangxian area, Gansu

events.titleEn: Red Fourth Front Army reaches a key point at Tongwei, Weiyuan, and Zhangxian area, Gansu
events.descriptionEn: On Sep 10, 1936, the Red Fourth Front Army reached an important destination in the route sequence around Tongwei, Weiyuan, and Zhangxian area, Gansu. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 红二、红六军团出发
events.description: 1936年9月11日，红二、红六军团在甘肃会宁一带出发。

events.title: 红四方面军占领将台堡
events.description: 1936年9月14日，红四方面军在宁夏西吉将台堡一带占领将台堡。

events.title: 红二、红六军团占领将台堡
events.description: 1936年9月14日，红二、红六军团在宁夏西吉将台堡一带占领将台堡。

events.title: 红二方面军占领成县、徽县、两当、康县等地
events.description: 红二方面军在甘肃南部开展成徽两康行动，扩大活动区域，随后向北转移。

location.name: 甘肃成县/徽县/两当/康县一带
location.nameEn: Chengxian, Huixian, Liangdang, and Kangxian area, Gansu

events.titleEn: Red Second Front Army conducts a campaign at Chengxian, Huixian, Liangdang, and Kangxian area, Gansu
events.descriptionEn: On Sep 15, 1936, the Red Second Front Army conducted a campaign that shaped the movement of nearby columns around Chengxian, Huixian, Liangdang, and Kangxian area, Gansu. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 红四方面军发布了静宁、会宁战役纲领
events.description: 1936年9月18日，红四方面军在甘肃会宁一带发布了静宁、会宁战役纲领。

events.title: 红四方面军占领青江驿、翟家所
events.description: 1936年9月30日，红四方面军在甘肃会宁一带占领青江驿、翟家所。

events.title: 甘肃东北部敌军试图阻止红军会师
events.description: 三大主力红军接近会师阶段，敌军仍试图在甘肃、宁夏周边阻止红军汇合，但会宁、将台堡会师最终完成。

location.name: 甘肃会宁—宁夏将台堡一线
location.nameEn: Huining-Jiangtaibao line between Gansu and Ningxia

events.titleEn: Enemy forces attempt to prevent final convergence in northeastern Gansu
events.descriptionEn: As the main Red Army forces approached convergence, enemy forces still tried to prevent them from meeting around Gansu and Ningxia.

events.title: 红四方面军占领会宁县城
events.description: 1936年10月2日，红四方面军在甘肃会宁一带占领会宁县城。

events.title: 红四方面军会师创造了条件
events.description: 1936年10月3日，红四方面军在甘肃会宁一带会师创造了条件。

events.title: 红二方面军渡渭河北上
events.description: 红二方面军经中央同意放弃甘南地区，开始渡渭河向北转移，奔向会师区域。
events.titleEn: Red Second Front Army maneuvers along the route at Wei River line, Gansu
events.descriptionEn: On Oct 4, 1936, the Red Second Front Army maneuvered through the area to redirect or continue the march around Wei River line, Gansu. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 红四方面军与红一方面军会宁会师
events.description: 红四方面军同红一方面军在甘肃会宁会师。这是三大主力会师过程中的关键条目之一。
events.titleEn: Red Fourth Front Army joins forces at Huining, Gansu
events.descriptionEn: On Oct 9, 1936, the Red Fourth Front Army joined with another Red Army force and advanced the convergence narrative around Huining, Gansu. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 红一方面军在会宁迎接红四方面军
events.description: 红一方面军部分兵力控制会宁、界石铺、将台堡等地，接应红四方面军北上会师。
events.titleEn: Central Red Army joins forces at Huining, Gansu
events.descriptionEn: On Oct 9, 1936, the Central Red Army joined with another Red Army force and advanced the convergence narrative around Huining, Gansu. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 红四方面军会师大会
events.description: 1936年10月10日，红四方面军在甘肃会宁一带会师大会。

events.title: 红一方面军在将台堡迎接红二方面军
events.description: 1936年10月22日，红一、红二方面军在将台堡胜利会师。该条目与10月9日会宁会师共同构成三大主力会师完成的历史过程。
events.titleEn: Central Red Army joins forces at Jiangtaibao, Xiji, Ningxia
events.descriptionEn: On Oct 22, 1936, the Central Red Army joined with another Red Army force and advanced the convergence narrative around Jiangtaibao, Xiji, Ningxia. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 红二方面军到达将台堡，三大主力会师完成
events.description: 红二方面军总指挥部及红二军团到达将台堡，与红一方面军胜利会师。至此，红一、红二、红四方面军三大主力会师完成，红军长征胜利结束。
events.titleEn: Red Second Front Army joins forces at Jiangtaibao, Xiji, Ningxia
events.descriptionEn: On Oct 22, 1936, the Red Second Front Army joined with another Red Army force and advanced the convergence narrative around Jiangtaibao, Xiji, Ningxia. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 陕甘根据地成为长征落脚点与抗战出发点
events.description: 各路红军会师后，陕甘根据地作为落脚点的意义进一步显现，并逐渐成为全民族抗战的重要出发点。
events.titleEn: Shaan-Gan Red Army records the Long March victory at Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia region
events.descriptionEn: On Oct 22, 1936, the Shaan-Gan Red Army records the final convergence and the Long March landing point around Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia region. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

events.title: 四路红军长征汇入陕甘宁，新的出发点形成
events.description: 到1936年10月，几路红军在西北完成战略汇合。长征保存了革命骨干，也使陕甘宁区域成为中国革命新的大本营。
events.titleEn: Shaan-Gan Red Army records the Long March victory at Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia region
events.descriptionEn: On Oct 22, 1936, the Shaan-Gan Red Army records the final convergence and the Long March landing point around Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia region. This entry keeps the chronological route, local context, and visual connection to adjacent events.

persons.name: 陈树湘
persons.summary: 红三十四师师长。湘江突围后负伤被俘并壮烈牺牲，“为苏维埃流尽最后一滴血”的事迹成为长征牺牲精神的重要象征。
persons.summaryEn: Commander of the 34th Division. After the Xiang River breakout, he was wounded, captured, and died heroically, becoming a defining symbol of sacrifice on the Long March.

persons.name: 邓萍
persons.summary: 红三军团参谋长。遵义战役前线侦察敌情时牺牲，是长征途中牺牲的红军高级指挥员之一。
persons.summaryEn: Chief of staff of the Red Third Corps. He was killed while reconnoitering enemy positions before the Zunyi fighting, one of the senior Red Army officers who died during the Long March.

persons.name: 吴焕先
persons.summary: 红二十五军政治委员。率部西征北上途中在甘肃泾川战斗中牺牲，人物线连接鄂豫皖、鄂豫陕与陕北落脚点。
persons.summaryEn: Political commissar of the Red Twenty-Fifth Army. He was killed near Jingchuan, Gansu during the army's northwestward movement, linking the Hubei-Henan-Anhui, Hubei-Henan-Shaanxi, and northern Shaanxi route stories.

persons.name: 刘志丹
persons.summary: 西北红军和陕甘根据地重要领导人。陕甘根据地成为长征落脚点的重要基础，刘志丹后在东征战斗中牺牲。
persons.summaryEn: A key leader of the northwestern Red Army and the Shaanxi-Gansu base area. The base he helped build became a crucial landing point for the Long March; he later died during the eastern expedition.

persons.name: 毛泽东
persons.summary: 中央红军长征中的重要领导人之一。人物线集中关联遵义会议、四渡赤水、会师和陕北落脚点等条目。
persons.summaryEn: One of the central leaders during the Long March. His timeline connects major nodes including the Zunyi Meeting, Chishui maneuvering, convergence, and the northern Shaanxi landing point.

persons.name: 周恩来
persons.summary: 中央红军长征中的重要领导人之一，多次出现在会议、渡河、作战调整与会师时刻中。
persons.summaryEn: A major central leader during the Long March, appearing across meeting, river-crossing, operational adjustment, and convergence nodes.

persons.name: 朱德
persons.summary: 红军重要领导人之一，人物线横跨中央红军、红四方面军会合及后续北上过程。
persons.summaryEn: A major Red Army leader whose timeline spans the Central Red Army route, convergence with the Fourth Front Army, and the continued northward movement.

persons.name: 刘伯承
persons.summary: 中央红军先遣部队重要指挥员。彝海结盟和强渡大渡河等条目体现军事行动与民族工作交织。
persons.summaryEn: An important commander in the Central Red Army advance units. His timeline links the Yihai alliance and the Dadu River crossing, where military action and ethnic-relations work intersected.

persons.name: 小叶丹
persons.summary: 彝族果基部落首领。彝海结盟后派向导帮助红军通过彝族地区，是地方群众与长征路线相连的重要人物。
persons.summaryEn: Leader of the Guoji Yi community. After the Yihai alliance, he sent guides to help the Red Army pass through Yi areas, connecting local communities to the Long March route.

persons.name: 贺龙
persons.summary: 红二、六军团和红二方面军重要领导人。人物线贯穿桑植出发、乌蒙山回旋、甘孜会师和将台堡会师。
persons.summaryEn: A major leader of the Second and Sixth Corps and the Red Second Front Army. His timeline runs from the Sangzhi departure through the Wumeng maneuver, Garze convergence, and Jiangtaibao convergence.

persons.name: 任弼时
persons.summary: 红二、六军团和红二方面军重要领导人。人物线体现红二方面军从湘鄂川黔到西北会师的政治组织脉络。
persons.summaryEn: A major leader of the Second and Sixth Corps and the Red Second Front Army. His timeline shows the political and organizational thread from the Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou base area to the final northwestern convergence.

persons.name: 贺捷生
persons.summary: 出生仅十八天即随红二、六军团踏上长征路。她的展板把宏大军事路线拉回到家庭、生命与战争的微观维度。
persons.summaryEn: Only eighteen days old when she was carried with the Second and Sixth Corps on the Long March. Her panel brings the grand military route back to family, life, and the human scale of war.

persons.name: 洪超
persons.summary: 红三军团红四师师长。长征初期在江西信丰百石村一带战斗中牺牲，是突围路线上较早牺牲的高级指挥员。
persons.summaryEn: Commander of the Red Fourth Division of the Third Corps. He was killed near Baishi during the early breakout, one of the early senior officer sacrifices on the route.

persons.name: 程翠林
persons.summary: 红三十四师政治委员。湘江战役中随绝命后卫部队掩护中央红军主力突围，大部壮烈牺牲。
persons.summaryEn: Political commissar of the 34th Division. During the Xiang River Campaign, he served with the covering force that protected the main column at devastating cost.

persons.name: 蔡中
persons.summary: 红三十四师政治部主任。湘江战役后卫掩护叙事中，他与陈树湘、程翠林共同构成红三十四师牺牲群像。
persons.summaryEn: Political department director of the 34th Division. His story helps form the collective sacrifice portrait of the 34th Division alongside Chen Shuxiang and Cheng Cuilin.

persons.name: 谢子长
persons.summary: 西北红军和陕北苏区创建人之一。中央红军到达陕北之前，西北根据地已经由长期斗争和牺牲支撑起来。
persons.summaryEn: One of the founders of the northwestern Red Army and Shaanbei Soviet area. Before the Central Red Army arrived, the northwestern base had already been sustained through long struggle and sacrifice.

persons.name: 罗南辉
persons.summary: 红四方面军高级指挥员。会宁会师前后在阻击战中牺牲，其人物线提醒观众：胜利记录背后仍有掩护与牺牲。
persons.summaryEn: A senior commander of the Red Fourth Front Army. He died in covering actions around the final convergence, reminding viewers that victory nodes still carried sacrifice.

persons.name: 彭德怀
persons.summary: 中央红军重要军事指挥员。人物线连接出发、娄山关、吴起镇和直罗镇等条目，体现长征后期从突围到立足陕北的军事转变。
persons.summaryEn: A major commander of the Central Red Army. His timeline connects the departure, Loushan Pass, Wuqi, and Zhiluozhen, showing the shift from breakout to foothold in northern Shaanxi.

persons.name: 张闻天
persons.summary: 中共中央重要领导人。人物线集中在通道、遵义、扎西、榜罗镇等会议条目，体现长征中的组织与路线调整。
persons.summaryEn: A major central leader whose timeline focuses on the Tongdao, Zunyi, Zhaxi, and Bangluo meetings, showing organizational and strategic adjustment during the march.

persons.name: 王稼祥
persons.summary: 中共中央与红军领导成员之一。遵义会议等条目中的人物线用于呈现长征决策层内部的调整过程。
persons.summaryEn: A central Party and Red Army leader. His timeline around the Zunyi Meeting shows the internal adjustment of leadership during the Long March.

persons.name: 贺子珍
persons.summary: 参加中央红军长征。川南生女并托孤的条目把战争行军、家庭分离和女性亲历者的痛苦联系在一起。
persons.summaryEn: A participant in the Central Red Army's Long March. The southern Sichuan childbirth and entrusting episode connects military movement, family separation, and women's lived experience.

persons.name: 邓颖超
persons.summary: 参加中央红军长征的女性革命者。人物线把卫生、宣传、组织和艰苦行军纳入路线叙事。
persons.summaryEn: A woman revolutionary who took part in the Central Red Army's Long March. Her timeline brings health, propaganda, organization, and arduous marching into the route narrative.

persons.name: 蔡畅
persons.summary: 参加中央红军长征的女性革命者。人物线用于补充妇女工作、群众动员和政治组织维度。
persons.summaryEn: A woman revolutionary who took part in the Central Red Army's Long March. Her timeline adds women's work, mass mobilization, and political organization to the route narrative.

persons.name: 康克清
persons.summary: 参加中央红军长征。她的展板补入女性干部、随军组织与长途行军中的生存经验。
persons.summaryEn: A participant in the Central Red Army's Long March. Her panel adds women cadres, accompanying organization, and survival experience on the march.

persons.name: 刘英
persons.summary: 参加中央红军长征的女性革命者。人物线可承接宣传、组织、通信和艰苦行军等微观叙事。
persons.summaryEn: A woman revolutionary who took part in the Central Red Army's Long March. Her timeline can carry micro-narratives of propaganda, organization, communication, and arduous travel.

persons.name: 李坚真
persons.summary: 参加中央红军长征的女性革命者。她的档案用于补足女性红军在路线中的多重劳动和政治经验。
persons.summaryEn: A woman revolutionary who took part in the Central Red Army's Long March. Her archive helps show women's multiple forms of work and political experience on the route.

persons.name: 徐海东
persons.summary: 红二十五军重要指挥员。人物线贯穿何家冲出发、独树镇突围、袁家沟口战斗和永坪会师。
persons.summaryEn: A major commander of the Red Twenty-Fifth Army. His timeline runs through Hejiachong, Dushuzhen, Yuanjiagoukou, and Yongping.

persons.name: 程子华
persons.summary: 红二十五军重要领导人之一。人物线显示红二十五军从鄂豫皖、鄂豫陕到陕北会师的独立路线。
persons.summaryEn: A major leader of the Red Twenty-Fifth Army. His timeline shows the army's independent route from Hubei-Henan-Anhui through Hubei-Henan-Shaanxi to northern Shaanxi.

persons.name: 徐向前
persons.summary: 红四方面军重要军事指挥员。人物线连接嘉陵江、懋功会师、甘孜会师和会宁会师。
persons.summaryEn: A major commander of the Red Fourth Front Army. His timeline connects the Jialing River campaign, Maogong convergence, Garze convergence, and Huining convergence.

persons.name: 陈昌浩
persons.summary: 红四方面军重要政治领导人。人物线用于呈现红四方面军长征中的政治组织、会师和路线分歧。
persons.summaryEn: A major political leader of the Red Fourth Front Army. His timeline shows political organization, convergence, and route disputes within the Fourth Front Army's Long March.

persons.name: 张国焘
persons.summary: 红四方面军路线分歧中的关键人物。该档案用于呈现长征并非单线胜利叙事，也包含严重分歧和组织危机。
persons.summaryEn: A key figure in route disputes within the Red Fourth Front Army. This profile keeps the Long March from becoming a single-line victory story by showing crisis and disagreement.

persons.name: 萧克
persons.summary: 红二、六军团和红二方面军重要指挥员。人物线连接桑植出发、乌蒙山回旋、甘孜整编和北上会师。
persons.summaryEn: A major commander of the Second and Sixth Corps and the Red Second Front Army. His timeline connects Sangzhi, the Wumeng maneuver, Garze reorganization, and final northward convergence.

persons.name: 王震
persons.summary: 红二、六军团和红二方面军重要指挥员。人物线可连接桑植出发、乌蒙山回旋和甘孜整编。
persons.summaryEn: A major commander in the Second and Sixth Corps and the Red Second Front Army. His timeline connects Sangzhi, Wumeng, and Garze reorganization.

persons.name: 关向应
persons.summary: 红二、六军团和红二方面军重要政治工作领导人。人物线体现红二方面军长征中的组织、宣传和整编过程。
persons.summaryEn: A major political-work leader of the Second and Sixth Corps and the Red Second Front Army. His timeline shows organization, propaganda, and reorganization during the march.

persons.name: 习仲勋
persons.summary: 陕甘边革命根据地重要创建者之一。人物线说明长征落脚点不是孤立终点，而是与西北地方革命长期经营相连。
persons.summaryEn: One of the important builders of the Shaanxi-Gansu border base. His timeline shows that the Long March landing point was connected to long-running local revolutionary work.

persons.name: 杜衡
persons.summary: 补充材料中出现的陕甘边早期组织和军事行动相关人物，用于补足西北根据地前史线索。

persons.name: 王世泰

halls.title: 总序厅
halls.subtitle: 为什么出发
halls.description: 从中央苏区出发、分路前进到西北会师，建立进入展馆的叙事主线。

halls.title: 第一展厅：长征路线全景
halls.subtitle: red-map 路线展板
halls.description: 以现有交互地图作为核心展板，连接路线、事件、人物和会师时刻。

halls.title: 第二展厅：英烈画像墙
halls.subtitle: 让名字重新拥有面容
halls.description: 以英烈名录、画像、牺牲地点和人物时间线组织烈士展板。

halls.title: 第三展厅：人物生命时间线
halls.subtitle: 从宏大路线回到具体的人
halls.description: 将人物与事件条目关联，展示每个人在长征叙事中的发展轨迹。

halls.title: 第四展厅：暗线代价
halls.subtitle: 胜利背后的牺牲如何被看见
halls.description: 从牺牲事件、损失口径与家庭离散进入长征的隐痛层。

halls.title: 第五展厅：战役、会议与转折
halls.subtitle: 关键环节如何改变路线
halls.description: 集中展示会议、战役、渡河、会师等决定路线变化的条目。

halls.title: 第六展厅：地点与纪念设施
halls.subtitle: 地点如何承载记忆
halls.description: 以于都、遵义、泸定、会宁、将台堡等历史现场组织展览。

halls.title: 第七展厅：资料档案与来源审校
halls.subtitle: 把证据留在展板背后
halls.description: 展示资料来源、口述线索、史料口径和待考证字段。

halls.title: 策展方法
halls.subtitle: 从研究材料到线上展馆
halls.description: 记录本项目如何把路线数据、人物档案和史料来源转译为网页展览。

halls.title: 纪念空间
halls.subtitle: 献花、留言与学习路径
halls.description: 提供沉静的纪念入口，让追思最终回到路线与人物本身。

exhibits.title: 资料档案与来源审校
exhibits.summary: 所有展板都保留来源 ID、资料口径和确定性字段。后续微信文章、游戏文本和地方志材料都应先进入研究目录，再整理为候选条目。
exhibits.summaryEn: Every panel keeps source IDs, certainty, and evidence notes. Future WeChat articles, game text, and local gazetteer materials should enter the research folder first and then become candidate entries.

exhibits.title: 暗线：牺牲与代价展板
exhibits.summary: 路线地图告诉我们“他们走到了哪里”，暗线展板追问“他们付出了什么”：后卫牺牲、战斗损失、家属离散、雪山草地与根据地长期支撑，层层叠加成胜利背后的重量。
exhibits.summaryEn: The map shows how columns arrived; the hidden-cost panel asks what sustained that arrival: covering-force sacrifice, battle losses, family separation, snow-mountain and grassland hardship, and long-running base work.

exhibits.title: 从路线进入名字
exhibits.summary: 这座线上博物馆以长征路线为经，以人物与英烈为纬。你可以先沿全局路线前行，也可以从一个名字进入，读见一段被战火改写的人生。
exhibits.summaryEn: The museum uses the Long March route as its structure and people as its living core. Visitors can begin from the full route or enter through a single name.

exhibits.title: 英烈画像与名录展板
exhibits.summary: 以烈士姓名、所属部队、牺牲记录、资料可信度组织画像墙。没有照片的个体也以“待考证铭牌”呈现，让缺失本身成为展览内容。
exhibits.summaryEn: The portrait wall is organized by name, force, sacrifice node, and source certainty. Individuals without surviving photographs are shown with research plaques so absence itself remains visible.

exhibits.title: 纪念与学习路径
exhibits.summary: 观众可从“路线、英烈、人物、地点、档案”五条路径进入。纪念空间保持克制：未经核实的肖像与原文不做展示，让尊重先于渲染。
exhibits.summaryEn: Visitors can learn through five paths: route, martyrs, people, places, and archives. The memorial space remains restrained and avoids publishing unverified portraits or long source text.

exhibits.title: 研究型数字策展方法
exhibits.summary: 本馆采用“研究材料、策展文本、叙事结构、视觉语言、前端实现、测试复盘”的工作流，把长征路线数据转译为可浏览的展览层级。
exhibits.summaryEn: The museum follows a workflow from research materials to curatorial copy, narrative structure, visual language, frontend implementation, and testing review.

exhibits.title: 人物生命时间线展板
exhibits.summary: 每个人物页都像一份微型传记：从生平到战场，从条目到归宿。点开一个名字，就能看到他或她如何在时代激流中留下自己的坐标。
exhibits.summaryEn: Each person panel combines basic biography, related events, route nodes, and source notes. Selecting a person reveals how their life connects to the map.

exhibits.title: 地点与纪念设施展板
exhibits.summary: 于都、遵义、泸定、吴起、会宁、将台堡等地点，不只是地理坐标，更是记忆被反复召唤的历史现场。
exhibits.summaryEn: This panel connects the route, people, and memorial spaces through places such as Yudu, Zunyi, Luding, Wuqi, Huining, and Jiangtaibao.

exhibits.title: 长征星火路线交互展板
exhibits.titleEn: Interactive Long March Spark Route Panel
exhibits.summary: 嵌入现有 red-map 作为核心路线展板。地图条目会继续承担事件播放、会师提示和路线筛选功能。
exhibits.summaryEn: The existing red-map is preserved as the core route panel, keeping event playback, convergence prompts, and route filtering.

exhibits.title: 战役会议与转折条目
exhibits.summary: 将遵义会议、四渡赤水、强渡大渡河、会宁与将台堡会师等条目组织为路线变化的因果链。
exhibits.summaryEn: This panel groups Zunyi, the Chishui maneuvers, the Dadu River crossing, Huining, and Jiangtaibao into a chain of decisions and route changes.

artifacts.title: 资料进入展馆的流程
artifacts.summary: 外部材料先进入研究目录，经过摘录、去重、事实拆分、来源标注和候选条目审校后，再进入正式 CSV。
artifacts.summaryEn: External material first enters the research folder, then moves through excerpting, deduplication, fact splitting, source tagging, and candidate review before entering official CSV files.

artifacts.title: 只剩姓名的名册
artifacts.summary: 部分英烈只有姓名、籍贯或部队线索，缺少照片和遗物。博物馆以“待考证铭牌”显示，不用想象替代证据。
artifacts.summaryEn: Some martyrs survive in the record only through names, hometowns, or force clues, without photographs or relics. The museum displays them as research plaques rather than inventing evidence.

artifacts.title: 随军婴儿的生命线
artifacts.titleEn: The Infant Carried with the Column
artifacts.summary: 贺捷生的展板把战争路线转化为家庭与生命的叙事，使观众看到宏大路线中的具体人。
artifacts.summaryEn: He Jiesheng's panel turns the military route into a story of family and life, helping visitors see individual lives within the larger route.

artifacts.title: red-map 作为总路线展板
artifacts.summary: 现有路线地图保留为博物馆核心展板，用于承接所有人物、事件和地点链接。
artifacts.summaryEn: The existing route map remains the museum's central digital panel and carries links to people, events, and places.

artifacts.title: 彝海结盟条目
artifacts.summary: 彝海结盟展现长征中的民族工作、纪律和地方协助，不只是军事行军条目。
artifacts.summaryEn: The Yihai alliance shows ethnic-relations work, discipline, and local support during the Long March, not merely a marching node.
